scripts.build: cat palavra-viva.part* | base64 -d > palavra-viva-bundle.zip && mkdir -p runtime-app && unzip -oq palavra-viva-bundle.zip -d runtime-app && cat pv-gz-part*.b64 | base64 -d | gzip -d > apply-palavra-viva-patch.cjs && node apply-palavra-viva-patch.cjs && cat pv-convo-part*.b64 | base64 -d | gzip -d > enhance-palavra-viva-conversation.cjs && node enhance-palavra-viva-conversation.cjs && cat pv-final-patch-part*.b64 | base64 -d | gzip -d > finalize-palavra-viva.cjs && node finalize-palavra-viva.cjs && cat pv-manifest-fix-part*.b64 | base64 -d | gzip -d > fix-manifest.cjs && node fix-manifest.cjs && cat pv-secure-release-part*.b64 | base64 -d > security-patch.tar.gz && tar -xzf security-patch.tar.gz -C runtime-app && cp _audit_source/package-lock.json runtime-app/package-lock.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p='runtime-app/package-lock.json'; const l=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); l.version='1.3.0'; l.packages[''].version='1.3.0'; fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(l,null,2)+'\\n');" && cd runtime-app && npm ci --omit=dev && npm test && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
